result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "line_id", "order_id", "product_id", "quantity", "line_total_cents" FROM "order_items"), __grouped AS (SELECT t3."region_label" AS "region", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."line_total_cents"), 0) / :scale_revenue), 2) AS "revenue", COALESCE(SUM(t0."quantity"), 0) AS "units" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "orders" t1 ON t0."order_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."order_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "customers" t2 ON t1."customer_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."customer_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "regions" t3 ON t2."region_id" COLLATE BINARY = t3."region_id" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t3."region_label") SELECT "region", "revenue", "units" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "revenue" DESC, "region" ASC LIMIT :result_limit

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT t4."tier" AS "plan_name", t2."country" AS "country", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."amount_cents"), 0) / :scale_billed_amount), 2) AS "billed_amount" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "invoices" t1 ON t0."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "subscriptions" t3 ON t0."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY = t3."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "plans" t4 ON t3."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY = t4."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "accounts" t2 ON t1."account_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."account_id" COLLATE BINARY WHERE t1."status" = :filter_0 GROUP BY t4."tier", t2."country") SELECT "plan_name", "country", "billed_amount" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "billed_amount" DESC, "plan_name" ASC, "country" ASC LIMIT :result_limit

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT p.tier AS plan_name,a.country,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS billed_amount FROM invoice_lines li LEFT JOIN invoices i ON li.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON i.account_id=a.account_id LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON li.subscription_id=s.subscription_id LEFT JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id=p.plan_id WHERE i.status='Paid' GROUP BY p.tier,a.country ORDER BY billed_amount DESC,plan_name ASC,country ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Account segments with above-average billed amount

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT t2."segment" AS "segment", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."amount_cents"), 0) / :scale_billed_amount), 2) AS "billed_amount" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "invoices" t1 ON t0."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "accounts" t2 ON t1."account_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."account_id" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t2."segment") SELECT "segment", "billed_amount" FROM __grouped WHERE "billed_amount" > (SELECT AVG("billed_amount") FROM __grouped) ORDER BY "billed_amount" DESC, "segment" ASC LIMIT :result_limit

cases.oracle_sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT a.segment,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS billed_amount FROM invoice_lines li LEFT JOIN invoices i ON li.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON i.account_id=a.account_id GROUP BY a.segment) SELECT segment,billed_amount FROM totals WHERE billed_amount>(SELECT AVG(billed_amount) FROM totals) ORDER BY billed_amount DESC,segment ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Billed amount by month including current and archived records

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines" UNION ALL SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "archived_invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT substr(t1."issued_on", 1, 7) AS "month", ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(t0."amount_cents"), 0) / :scale_billed_amount), 2) AS "billed_amount" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "invoices" t1 ON t0."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY substr(t1."issued_on", 1, 7)) SELECT "month", "billed_amount" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "month" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of invoice-line amounts in dollars before credits, across every invoice status unless filtered. Includes current and archived fact rows; every row is retained, including overlapping archive rows.
result.title: Billed amount by Month

cases.oracle_sql: WITH all_lines AS (SELECT entry_id,invoice_id,subscription_id,seat_quantity,amount_cents FROM invoice_lines UNION ALL SELECT entry_id,invoice_id,subscription_id,seat_quantity,amount_cents FROM archived_invoice_lines) SELECT substr(i.issued_on,1,7) AS month,ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(li.amount_cents),0)/100.0,2) AS billed_amount FROM all_lines li LEFT JOIN invoices i ON li.invoice_id=i.invoice_id GROUP BY substr(i.issued_on,1,7) ORDER BY month ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Seats by plan tier in US or India where seats on each line exceed 10

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT t4."tier" AS "plan_name", COALESCE(SUM(t0."seat_quantity"), 0) AS "seats" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "invoices" t1 ON t0."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY = t1."invoice_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "subscriptions" t3 ON t0."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY = t3."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "plans" t4 ON t3."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY = t4."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "accounts" t2 ON t1."account_id" COLLATE BINARY = t2."account_id" COLLATE BINARY WHERE t2."country" IN (:filter_0_0, :filter_0_1) AND t0."seat_quantity" > :filter_1 GROUP BY t4."tier") SELECT "plan_name", "seats" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "seats" DESC, "plan_name" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Sum of billed seat quantities on invoice lines.
result.title: Seats by Plan tier

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT p.tier AS plan_name,COALESCE(SUM(li.seat_quantity),0) AS seats FROM invoice_lines li LEFT JOIN invoices i ON li.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN accounts a ON i.account_id=a.account_id LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON li.subscription_id=s.subscription_id LEFT JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id=p.plan_id WHERE a.country IN ('US','India') AND li.seat_quantity>10 GROUP BY p.tier ORDER BY seats DESC,plan_name ASC LIMIT 100

cases.question: Invoices and seats by plan tier

telemetry.model_cost_basis: local inference; hardware and electricity excluded

result.sql: WITH __facts AS (SELECT "entry_id", "invoice_id", "subscription_id", "seat_quantity", "amount_cents" FROM "invoice_lines"), __grouped AS (SELECT t4."tier" AS "plan_name", COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT t0."invoice_id"), 0) AS "invoices", COALESCE(SUM(t0."seat_quantity"), 0) AS "seats" FROM __facts t0 LEFT JOIN "subscriptions" t3 ON t0."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY = t3."subscription_id" COLLATE BINARY LEFT JOIN "plans" t4 ON t3."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY = t4."plan_id" COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t4."tier") SELECT "plan_name", "invoices", "seats" FROM __grouped ORDER BY "invoices" DESC, "plan_name" ASC LIMIT :result_limit
result.explanation: Distinct invoices represented by selected lines; one invoice may contain several plans. Sum of billed seat quantities on invoice lines.
result.title: Invoices, Seats by Plan tier

cases.oracle_sql: SELECT p.tier AS plan_name,COUNT(DISTINCT li.invoice_id) AS invoices,COALESCE(SUM(li.seat_quantity),0) AS seats FROM invoice_lines li LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON li.subscription_id=s.subscription_id LEFT JOIN plans p ON s.plan_id=p.plan_id GROUP BY p.tier ORDER BY invoices DESC,plan_name ASC LIMIT 100
